initiative.title: A project's agent on its page
initiative.body: Members talk to a project's agent on the project page and it makes targeted, approved edits to the project. Runs on a Coax port of the Claude Agent SDK on our hosted agent runner.

milestones.title: Talk to the project agent on the page
milestones.body: The Coax Claude Agent SDK, the runner, oa-api sessions and the page panel.

milestones.title: /chat: a direct chat with the OpenAgents agent
milestones.body: openagents.com/chat: admins talk to a Claude agent with read access to the public openagents repository, on the same hosted runner as the project agent, in a general mode.

tasks.title: Coax Claude Agent SDK: transport and messages
tasks.body:
Port the transport and stream messages of the Rust crate claude_agent_sdk (0b401561a0^:crates/claude_agent_sdk) to Coax: spawn `claude` with stream-json in and out in its own process group through a C shim in coax/platform/, read lines, parse every SDKMessage type into typed values, unknown types kept raw.

Spec: `docs/project-agent.md`.
acceptance: Recorded stream-json fixtures from the crate's tests parse the same way
A live smoke runs one query against the installed CLI and prints the result and cost
Killing a query stops the whole process group

tasks.title: Coax Claude Agent SDK: control protocol, permissions and SDK MCP tools
tasks.body:
initialize, can_use_tool, hook_callback, mcp_message, interrupt, set_model and set_permission_mode, both ways; QueryOptions into flags and initialize fields; an in-process SDK MCP server for typed tools.

Spec: `docs/project-agent.md`.
acceptance: The live smoke calls one in-process MCP tool and denies a built-in tool through the permission callback
Control fixtures from the crate's tests pass

tasks.title: oa-api: agent sessions, events, queue and approvals
tasks.body:
Session and event tables shaped like openagents.agent.managed.v1, a member message queue, turn records for UNDO TURN, an approved-projects list, and a signed wake call to the runner. Members use their session cookie; the runner uses the project's agent key.

Spec: `docs/project-agent.md`.
acceptance: A non-approved project's agent routes answer the same not found
UNDO TURN restores the document version from before the turn
Tests in test.sh

tasks.title: oa-agent runner on Cloud Run
tasks.body:
Container with the claude CLI and the Coax SDK binary, the project MCP tools from the spec, Read/Glob/Grep/Edit/Write limited to a per-turn checkout of the linked repository (Bash and web off), one commit per turn pushed with a deploy key from Secret Manager, Claude Sonnet 5.5, the Anthropic key from Secret Manager in the child environment only, a daily spend cap and one turn at a time per project. Scale to zero.

Spec: `docs/project-agent.md`.
acceptance: A wake runs one turn and streams its events to oa-api on staging
A turn that edits a file pushes one commit; UNDO TURN pushes its revert
The key appears in no log, event or response
Over the cap, the turn refuses and the page says why

tasks.title: The AGENT panel on a project page
tasks.body:
Conversation, text box, a working line, STOP, and diff cards for each document edit and commit, UNDO TURN, and NEEDS BOTH on proposed goals; drawn in Coax; polling while a turn runs.

Spec: `docs/project-agent.md`.
acceptance: A member's message gets an answer and an applied edit on staging, desktop and phone (headless shots)
UNDO TURN puts the document and the repository back

tasks.title: Project agent live for the first approved project
tasks.body:
End to end on production for the first approved project, with the spend cap set.

Spec: `docs/project-agent.md`.
acceptance: Both members can talk to it on production
The edit log shows each change with the message that caused it

tasks.title: oa-api: chat conversations, turns and events
tasks.body:
chat.c and migration 0021_chat.sql: conversations, turns and events shaped like managed-agent sessions (openagents.agent.managed.v1, protocol spec §18.2), admins only (the NIP-98 admin sign-in and the phone sign-in), a message wakes the runner in general mode, STOP, a model per conversation (Haiku, Sonnet or Opus 5.5 only) and a $10/day cap on OpenAgents' key across models.

Spec: `docs/chat.md`.
acceptance: A non-admin gets the dashboard's 401/403 and nothing else
A follow-up resumes the conversation's CLI session
Over the cap, send answers 429 and says so
Only the three Claude model ids are accepted

tasks.title: The runner's general mode for /chat
tasks.body:
chat-runner.c (included by runner.c) and the chat.coax engine: a read-only sparse, blobless checkout of openagents main refreshed each turn, Read/Glob/Grep inside it plus WebSearch and WebFetch, Edit/Write/Bash/Task refused by the permission callback, session files kept in a mounted bucket, the model switchable on resume.

Spec: `docs/chat.md`.
acceptance: A question about a file is answered from the checkout and names it
An Edit or Bash attempt is refused
STOP interrupts a running turn
A model switch mid-conversation takes the next turn

tasks.title: /chat page in Coax
tasks.body:
chat.coax: the conversations and NEW CHAT, the conversation with Markdown drawn cleanly, the tool in use, STOP, the model picker by the text box, the model and credential on each answer, the cap message, SIGN IN for anyone else; works at 390 px.

Spec: `docs/chat.md`.
acceptance: Desktop and 390 px shots read cleanly
Signed out it draws only SIGN IN
The hidden main is the h1 and one link

tasks.title: Bring your own Anthropic API key or Claude subscription token
tasks.body:
KEY on /chat: an API key (models list) or a claude setup-token token (a minimal Haiku CLI turn) is checked, sealed by the runner with AES-256-GCM under a Secret Manager key, used only in the CLI child's environment (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, never both) with no cap from us, shown only as its kind and last four, and REMOVE deletes it. An expired token says so and is marked expired.

Spec: `docs/chat.md`.
acceptance: A bad key is refused with the reason and nothing is saved
A saved key or token runs a turn as YOUR KEY
REMOVE deletes it
Neither shows in any log, event or response

tasks.title: Project agents on the member's own Claude key or subscription token
tasks.body:
One credential store per signed-in pubkey, shared with /chat: the same KEY item on each project page. A project turn runs on the credential of the member who sent the message, with no cap from us and no charge to the project's $10 a day; with none saved, on OpenAgents' key under that cap. Another member's credential is never used. The runner gets the asker's sealed credential with the turn and passes exactly one variable to the CLI child (fresh CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, no --bare); an expired token says so and is marked expired.

Spec: `docs/chat.md`.
acceptance: A project turn on the fixture runs on the member's saved subscription token
With none saved it runs on OpenAgents' key under the cap
Another member's credential is never used
No credential appears in the logs

tasks.title: /chat live for admins
tasks.body:
oa-api and the runner deployed, the page released, /chat routed to the site in production, one production check on Haiku.

Spec: `docs/chat.md`.
acceptance: An admin opens /chat on production and gets an answer
The staging checks pass on Haiku
